character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Chibi female fantasy warrior, full-body pixel art game character, 48x48 sprite, 8 directions. Long flowing white hair with coral pink bangs and pink hair on the top of her head. A small dark floral hair ornament. Calm, elegant expression. In the front view, show two slightly larger, expressive eyes, clearly separated with visible skin between them. Keep the bangs above the eyes and the face clearly visible. Simple facial features with minimal shading. Wearing a fitted white short dress with black trim, a long black open coat with deep red lining, and black thigh-high stockings with black boots. Red and orange accents on one sleeve. Both hands are empty, with no weapons or objects. Large head and small body, elegant standing pose, clear silhouette, clean and readable pixel art. Keep the design consistent across all directions.
